sources.title: Cross Entropy Loss in Language Model Evaluation
sources.snippet: Cross entropy loss measures the performance of a classification model whose output is a probability distribution. In the context of language models, it quantifies the difference between the predicted probability distribution of the next token and the actual distribution (usually a one-hot encoded vector representing the true next token).
